configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Single-config Ninja, one build folder per preset, compile_commands.json for tools.

configurePresets.name: windows-base
configurePresets.description: MSVC from VS 2026 Build Tools, found by cmake/toolchains/windows-msvc.cmake: no Developer PowerShell needed. The environment copy reaches JUCE's nested juceaide configure. Never set CMAKE_C_FLAGS/CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS here.

configurePresets.name: windows-profile
configurePresets.displayName: Windows Profile (MSVC + Ninja: Release with symbols)
configurePresets.description: As fast as Release, with debug symbols: for playing and testing every day, profiling, and reading crash dumps of an optimised build (CMakeLists.txt makes RelWithDebInfo inline and link as Release does).

configurePresets.name: windows-asan
configurePresets.description: MSVC's AddressSanitizer over a Debug build: memory errors in the code only Windows builds (the sandbox's shared memory, the helper's windows, WASAPI and ASIO). Needs Visual Studio's C++ AddressSanitizer component (tools/setup-windows.cmd adds it). CMakeLists.txt puts the sanitizer's runtime next to each program.

configurePresets.name: linux-asan
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. CMAKE_<LANG>_FLAGS reach both compile and link steps.

configurePresets.name: linux-tsan
configurePresets.description: ThreadSanitizer needs optimisation and JUCE forces -O0 in Debug, hence RelWithDebInfo. On Ubuntu 24.04/WSL2 run the app under 'setarch $(uname -m) -R' (GCC 13/14 TSan vs vm.mmap_rnd_bits=32). -Wno-tsan: GCC warns that TSan doesn't model atomic_thread_fence, which Phazite's engine and JUCE use.

configurePresets.name: linux-clang
configurePresets.description: Clang in place of GCC (the clang and clang++ on the PATH; Ubuntu 24.04: 18), so that a second compiler sees the code macOS will build with; and the build folder that tools/clang-tidy.sh analyses, so without precompiled headers, which clang-tidy can't read.

testPresets.name: test-base
testPresets.description: Runs phazite_tests (doctest) after a build of the same preset, once for each test file, 4 at once (as many as CI's runners have processors; -j <n> changes that); prints a failing test's output.

testPresets.name: linux-asan
testPresets.description: Known leaks in JUCE, which Phazite can't change, would be suppressed in tools/lsan-suppressions.txt (none now). A crash is reported by AddressSanitizer, with its stack, not by doctest's signal handler (allow_user_segv_handler=0), so that CI annotates where it was. Undefined behaviour ends the test program at its first report, with its stack (halt_on_error=1): by default UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer only prints and carries on, which no test would notice; tests/TestMain.cpp names the test that ran.

testPresets.name: linux-tsan
testPresets.description: Known data races in JUCE, which Phazite can't change, would be suppressed in tools/tsan-suppressions.txt (none now). A crash is reported by ThreadSanitizer, with its stack, not by doctest's signal handler (allow_user_segv_handler=0).
